# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Ookauheieah, aungayootmang, eilvich einiktaheima eilichoheilotin sooli pikhaheitcopolotin. Ookauheieach ahkoovuk syaktoiliah sungeepnune; nohleiliah oomalholiknune. Autlamik aungayotachuke ahvatipcoon, ekahyokti nuvaynami, engmik pityi.
